title: Skvrampel tray
description:
This basic tray was originally designed as a sorting board, but I find myself using it daily for spreading out things: pouring out beads to check, laying out small findings for a project or when unboxing them, or catching spills when distributing beads. Sometimes I even use it as a plain white background to take quick photos.

It is basically a simple box, but the key feature is its low profile and solid grip on the desk. It’s practically impossible to flip over by accident.
